name: Personality Development and Yogasana Training Camp (TASP)
benefit: - **Training and Development:** The scheme offers a seven-day residential training camp focused on personality development and yogasana. The training covers aspects of physical fitness, mental well-being, and spiritual awareness. > **Note:** A total of 50 tribal youths (both male and female) are selected from each of the 17 targeted districts.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
